overview.description: The EA Bridgeway Select Small-Cap Value ETF (BRSV) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in small-cap stocks. The fund is an actively-managed ETF that invests primarily in small-cap value companies. The fund seeks long-term capital growth. BRSV was launched on Jul 24, 2026 and is issued by Alpha Architect.
